stocktwits.name: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.
stocktwits.why: GTA VIs near-perfect early reviews and enormous preorder demand are driving attention to Take-Two ahead of the games launch. Many traders are bullish on the franchises sales and future monetization, while others argue the expectations are already priced in and warn of a sell-the-news reaction.

Bulls welcomed the results and breakout, while skeptics argued the valuation is stretched and questioned the acquisition, with some expecting the rally to fade.
